theme.description: A pristine, ultra-functional, high-density dashboard inspired by Bloomberg Terminals but executed in a brilliant light theme. Relies on stark white backgrounds, dense grid logic, and monospaced typography to display thousands of data points without visual fatigue.

rules: NO Inter for headings. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Chivo' for any large display text (market overview stats, logo marks).
MANDATORY: Use 'JetBrains Mono' or 'Roboto Mono' for ALL numbers, ticker symbols, and table data. This ensures tabular figures align perfectly when scanning 600+ rows.
Use 'Inter' or 'IBM Plex Sans' strictly for small UI labels, table headers, and tooltips.
Apply 'tracking-tight' to headings and 'tracking-tighter' to large metrics.
Use fluid typography scales, capping H1s at text-4xl due to the dashboard nature (we need screen real estate).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High-Density Table Protocol. We are building a command center.
spacing_and_layout.table_density: Row heights must be tight (32px - 36px) to maximize data visibility. Padding inside table cells should be py-1 px-2 or py-1.5 px-3.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use Mode B: High Density Grid for the top market overview strip. gap-2 or gap-4. Every pixel must be utilized.
structure: Top Header: Brand, Live Status Indicator (pulsing dot), Global Search.
Market Overview Strip: 4-5 small Bento metrics (BTC price, ETH gas, Total Market Cap, 24h Vol) using CoinGecko/Coinbase data concepts.
Control Bar: Sticky row containing the 15 Timeframe toggle pills (1s, 5s... 10d) + Filters.
Main Scanner: Virtualized Data Table taking up exactly the remaining viewport height (h-[calc(100vh-200px)]). The table MUST NOT cause page-level scroll; the table body itself scrolls.

instructions_to_main_agent: VIRTUALIZATION IS MANDATORY: You must use @tanstack/react-virtual or react-window for the token list. Rendering 600+ DOM nodes that update every 1 second will crash the browser without it.

TIMEFRAME SELECTOR: Create a horizontally scrollable segmented control for the 15 timeframes. Active state should be a crisp border or solid black background with white text. Inactive should be transparent with dark gray text.

TABLE DESIGN: Flat, solid surfaces. 1px bottom border on rows (border-zinc-100). Hover state on rows: bg-zinc-50. Freeze the header and the first column (Ticker Symbol). Numeric columns MUST be text-right.
ICONS: Install and use 'react-icons' for API brand logos (SiBinance, SiCoinbase, FaEthereum, FaBitcoin) rather than trying to load external images. For general UI, use 'lucide-react'.
customizations: Do NOT use thick Shadcn cards for the main table. Strip away shadows entirely.
Data Ticking Animation: When a trade count updates, briefly flash the cell background or text color (green/red) and fade back to neutral within 500ms using CSS transitions.
Inputs/Search: Use 'border-b-2' minimal style or ultra-crisp rectangular inputs. No pill-shaped search bars.

rules: Use optical clarity: borders are #E4E4E7 (zinc-200), not muddy grays.
The 'Live' indicator should be a small 8px pulsing green circle (use framer-motion or CSS keyframes for a ping effect) located in the header.
Empty space is not wasted space in the control bar. Group timeframe toggles on the left, search/filter on the right.
Keep standard UI motion fast (0.15s ease).
Data updates must NOT cause layout shifts. Use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) in CSS to keep digit widths static.
Hover states on table rows must be instantaneous to feel performant.
Ensure color contrast for text exceeds 4.5:1. (e.g., #52525B on #FFFFFF).
Do NOT rely on color alone to indicate change; use up/down arrows or +/- signs where relevant.
Add explicit aria-labels to the timeframe buttons.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='timeframe-btn-1s', data-testid='token-row-BTCUSDT', data-testid='search-input').

media_and_icons.strategy: Vector over Raster. The UI is too dense and professional for generic stock photos.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions ONLY for specific properties.
Do NOT use thick gradients, shadows, or rounded-3xl corners. This is a pro-trading tool, not a consumer social app.
Use tabular-nums class on all numbers to prevent horizontal jitter during the 1-second auto-refresh.
Do NOT center align the app container. Full width, max-w-full, left-aligned standard dashboard layout.
Install and setup @tanstack/react-virtual immediately—the app requires handling massive DOM updates.
Build the 15 timeframe options exactly as requested: 1s, 5s, 15s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 1d, 4d, 7d, 10d.
